description: Create a Gemini Omni task on RunAPI (text to video). Returns a task id, status, and output URLs.

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio. Declared type: string. Known values: "16:9", "9:16".

audio_ids.description: Audio preset IDs returned by create-audio. Declared type: array.

callback_url.description: Webhook URL for terminal Task delivery. Declared type: string.

character_ids.description: Character IDs returned by create-character; dual-image characters consume two of the shared seven reference units. Declared type: array.

duration_seconds.description: Output duration in seconds. Declared type: integer.

first_frame_image_url.description: Public first-frame image URL; mutually exclusive with reference images, audio IDs, video clips, and character IDs. Declared type: string.

last_frame_image_url.description: Public last-frame image URL; requires first_frame_image_url. Declared type: string.

model.description: RunAPI model slug for this model line.

output_resolution.description: Output resolution. Declared type: string. Known values: "360p", "720p", "1080p", "4k".

prompt.description: Video generation prompt. Declared type: string.

reference_image_urls.description: Public reference image URLs; images, video clips, and characters share a seven-unit reference limit. Declared type: array.

seed.description: Deterministic generation seed. Declared type: integer.

video_list.description: Source video clips; each clip consumes two reference units. Declared type: array.

wait.description: Poll until the task reaches a terminal status.

name: text_to_video
